description: What the Studio HTTP suite must notice of the plan routes of P9 ac-10 (docs/PLAN-MODE.md "The plan and its revision"): POST /api/studio/plan/set always writes as the user and keeps its fields; POST /api/studio/plan/decide refuses a bad task id, decision or revision, a request for changes without feedback or with an execution, and answers 404 when no plan waits. What the routes do with a plan request that waits is in plan-model.json (verify-plan-mode, through a real Hub).

mutations.name: Q1
mutations.what: the page can write a plan as the model

mutations.name: Q2
mutations.what: the page's edit of the plan text is dropped

mutations.name: Q3
mutations.what: the plan decision route takes any task id

patches.old: if(typeof payload.taskId!=='string'||!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(payload.taskId))throw Object.assign(new Error('Cần ID hội thoại hợp lệ.'),{code:'bad_task_id',statusCode:400});

mutations.name: Q4
mutations.what: the plan decision route takes any decision

mutations.name: Q5
mutations.what: the plan decision route takes a missing or broken revision

mutations.name: Q6
mutations.what: changes can be requested without feedback

mutations.name: Q7
mutations.what: a request for changes takes an execution choice

mutations.name: Q8
mutations.what: a decision for a task with no plan waiting is not answered with 404

patches.old: if(!planRequest)throw Object.assign(new Error('Tác vụ này không có kế hoạch nào đang chờ duyệt.'),{code:'no_plan_request',statusCode:404});
